title: 2-D CFAR Detector
text: 二维恒虚警率 (CFAR) 检测器，输入 3 路、输出 3 路；按 {Size in cells of the guard region band} 指定保护带的宽度；{CFAR algorithm} 指定噪声功率估计算法、{Rank of order statistic} 指定顺序统计量的秩、{Size in cells of the training region band} 指定训练带的宽度、{Threshold factor method} 确定阈值因子的方法、{Custom threshold factor} 指定自定义阈值因子、{Probability of false alarm} 指定虚警概率、{OutputFormat} 指定检测结果的格式 CUT、{Output threshold detection} 启用检测阈值输出、{Output estimated noise power} 启用检测阈值输出、{Source of the number of detections} 指定要报告的检测数量的来源、{Maximum number of detections} 指定要报告的检测索引最大数量，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入图像 real M -by- N matrix | real M -by- N -by- P array

ports.name: idx
ports.summary: 测试单元的位置 2 -by- L matrix of positive integers

ports.name: K
ports.summary: 检测阈值因子 positive scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 检测结果 logical matrix (default) | real-valued matrix

ports.name: Th
ports.summary: 计算出的检测阈值 real-valued matrix

ports.name: N
ports.summary: 估计的噪声功率 real-valued matrix

params.name: CFAR algorithm
params.values: 噪声功率估计算法 CA (default) | GOCA | SOCA | OS

params.name: Rank of order statistic
params.values: 顺序统计量的秩 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Size in cells of the guard region band
params.values: 保护带的宽度 [1,1] (default) | nonnegative integer scalar | 2-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Size in cells of the training region band
params.values: 训练带的宽度 [1,1] (default) | nonnegative integer scalar | 2-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Threshold factor method
params.values: 确定阈值因子的方法 Auto (default) | Input port | Custom

params.name: Custom threshold factor
params.values: 自定义阈值因子 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Probability of false alarm
params.values: 虚警概率 0.1 (default) | real scalar between 0 and 1

params.name: OutputFormat
params.values: 检测结果的格式 CUT result (default) | Detection index

params.name: Output threshold detection
params.values: 启用检测阈值输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Output estimated noise power
params.values: 启用检测阈值输出 off (default) | on

params.values: 要报告的检测索引最大数量 1 (default) | positive integer
